en.title: China Itinerary Planning: Build a First Trip That Fits
en.headline: China itinerary planning: build a first trip that fits the nights you have
en.description: Plan a first China itinerary by counting usable days, choosing city roles and gateways, pricing in transfers, protecting bookings and matching the route to your pace.
